South Korea Eases FX Rules Amidst Volatile Stock Market

South Korea is easing foreign exchange rules to facilitate easier trading of the Won for foreigners. This move comes as the country's stock market experiences significant volatility, with its stock index proving more volatile than Bitcoin. The frenzied trading has also highlighted risks associated with margin loans.
